data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a positive deviation of GBP 10.9m (2013: positive deviation of GBP 5.0m); this comprises of releases GBP 8.5m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and GBP 2.4m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 the gross claims outstanding (opening reserves) were GBP 517.695m. The syndicate reports a net prior-year release of GBP 10.9m (favourable development), comprising GBP 8.5m of releases in direct Third Party Liability and GBP 2.4m in respect of reinsurance business. The report provides only the NET (after reinsurance) prior-year movement; no gross prior-year movement figure is disclosed in the movement note.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a positive deviation of GBP 10.9m (2013: positive deviation of GBP 5.0m); this comprises of releases GBP 8.5m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and GBP 2.4m in respect of total Reinsurance business.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (liabilities) prior-year comparative column. The movement in prior year's provision note provides only a NET (after reinsurance) prior-year figure (GBP 10.9m release) and a breakdown by direct Third Party Liability (GBP 8.5m) and Reinsurance (GBP 2.4m). No gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement figure is disclosed; therefore the reported prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the net figure as a fallback and is flagged accordingly.
